celebrates: Historic Downtown Parkville holds its first annual Mayor's Tree Lighting at Pocket Park on Saturday, November 28, with the Voices of Kansas City, a balloon artist, a build-your-own-bear vendor, free cookies and hot chocolate and a commemorative ornament for sale. Christmas on the River follows in December. The Parkville branch of Mid-Continent Public Library hosts Dino O'Dell's holiday music show and a Santa storytime, and nearby Riverside lights its city tree at Welcome Plaza on December 3. Libraries in Riverside, Platte City and Weston host Santa storytimes in December.
facts: The 2026 Mayor's Tree Lighting is billed as the first annual one in Historic Downtown Parkville. Pocket Park is at 100 Main Street, at 1st and Main Street. The Riverside tree lighting is at Welcome Plaza, 4510 NW Gateway Avenue, where the library branch is also located. The Parkville library is at 8815 Tom Watson Parkway. Platte City's Candy Cane Lane lighting celebration was held on November 25.

faq: When is the Parkville tree lighting?
The first annual Mayor's Tree Lighting is Saturday, November 28, 2026, at Pocket Park, 100 Main Street. Activities start at 6:30 pm, entertainment at 7 pm and the tree is lit at 7:30 pm.
What can kids do at the Parkville tree lighting?
The host lists a balloon artist and a build-your-own-bear vendor in the alley, plus free cookies and hot chocolate from local businesses in Pocket Park.
Is there a Riverside tree lighting?
Yes. The City of Riverside lights its Christmas tree at Welcome Plaza, 4510 NW Gateway Avenue, on Thursday, December 3, from 5:30 to 7 pm, with the Mayor's lighting at 6 pm.
Where can kids see Santa near Parkville?
Mid-Continent Public Library branches host Santa programs in Parkville (December 1 and 21), Riverside (December 8), Platte City (December 8) and Weston (December 18). Most require registration.
